name: Scaffold a full-stack todo app
prompt: Build me a full-stack todo application with Express backend and React frontend. Use SQLite for the database, REST API, JWT auth, and feature-first structure.
expected_behaviors: Feature-first directory structure (not layer-first)
Three-layer architecture (controller → service → repository)
Centralized typed config with startup validation
Typed error hierarchy with global error handler
JWT auth middleware with short expiry access token
Structured JSON logging with request ID
Input validation on all endpoints (Zod)
Health check endpoints (/health, /ready)
API client with token auto-attach on frontend
Build check passes before completion
CORS with explicit origins

name: Add auth to existing API
prompt: Add JWT authentication to my Express API. I need login, register, and a protected route. Use typed errors and middleware for auth. The frontend is React with React Query.
expected_behaviors: Auth middleware in standard middleware order position
JWT with short expiry (15min) + refresh token
Typed error classes (UnauthorizedError, etc.)
httpOnly cookie for refresh token, not localStorage on frontend
Transparent token refresh on 401 in API client
RBAC middleware if roles mentioned
User-facing error messages (not raw API errors)

name: Add proper error handling
prompt: Set up error handling for my Express API. I need typed error classes, a global error handler, and proper error responses. Also map errors on the React frontend to user-friendly messages.
expected_behaviors: Typed error hierarchy (AppError base + NotFoundError, ValidationError, etc.)
Global error handler middleware as last middleware
Operational errors get structured JSON response with code, status, detail
Programming errors get logged with stack trace + generic 500 response
Never return stack traces to client
Frontend error mapper with human-readable messages per status code
401 → 'Please log in', 403 → permission, 404 → not found, etc.
Network error (TypeError 'Failed to fetch') → connection message
